start: Members, Add member, signed in as owner; the gym has no batch yet

steps.action: Open the add-member form and find 'Batch (optional)'
user_sees: A text box with the hint 'Up to 40 letters.' (no chips yet)
must_not: Batch is required to save

steps.action: Type 'Morning 6-8' and save the member
user_sees: The member is saved with that batch
must_not: The batch saved with extra spaces

steps.action: Add a second member
user_sees: 'Morning 6-8' is offered as a chip, the most used batch first; one tap picks it
must_not: The chip missing
The same batch as two chips

steps.action: Open Members and the batch filter
user_sees: 'All batches (N)' and 'Morning 6-8 (2)'; picking it lists the two members
must_not: A count that differs from the rows
Members of another batch listed

start: Add or edit member, signed in as owner; 'Morning 6-8' exists

steps.action: Type 'morning   6-8' and save
user_sees: Saved as the gym's first spelling 'Morning 6-8'
must_not: A second batch in the filter

steps.action: Type only spaces and save
user_sees: The member has no batch
must_not: An empty chip
A batch named with spaces

steps.action: Type more than 40 letters
user_sees: The box stops at 40 letters or says so (which: unknown, not read in code)
must_not: A long name cut without a word
A chip that breaks the layout

start: Members with the batch filter, signed in as owner

steps.action: Pick 'Morning 6-8' in the filter, then archive its last member
user_sees: The picked batch stays in the filter with (0) until another is picked
must_not: The filter jumps to another batch
The list shows everyone while the filter still names the batch

steps.action: Pick 'All batches' and open the filter again
user_sees: A batch that only archived members carry is not offered
must_not: A '(0)' batch offered

steps.action: Edit a member and clear the batch
user_sees: The member is under the no-batch choice and the batch count is one lower
must_not: The old batch still shown on the member

steps.action: Bring the archived member back
user_sees: The batch is offered again with its count
must_not: The member comes back without the batch

start: Other places the batch is used, signed in as owner: Attendance and Messages & offers

steps.action: On Attendance pick a batch above the check-in box and type a name from another batch
user_sees: 'Nobody matches that' and 'Searching only <batch>. Pick “All batches” to search everyone.'
must_not: A member of another batch offered
No hint why nobody matches

steps.action: Pick a batch with nobody in it today
user_sees: 'Nobody in this batch'
must_not: A blank list

steps.action: On Messages & offers pick the group 'In one batch' and the batch
user_sees: Only members of that batch who are not archived are in the group
must_not: Members with no batch in the group
